chapter: Jazz opinions, Jelly Roll and the Rhythm Club
title: Eubie Blake, Noble Sissle and the 1920s shows
summary: He heard Blake and Sissle in Cincinnati in 1924 and stood outside to listen.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you about some of the shows they were having during the late 20's such as "Shuffle Along". Did you catch any of those "Blackbird" shows of the 20's?

No. I was at school then. Yeah, because I remember when they came to Cincinnati. They came to Cincinnati in 1924 and I went to the theatre to hear them... Eubie Blake and Noble Sissle. After the show broke up then Eubie Blake and Noble Sissle came back to Cincinnati, just as a team. I went out to hear them
several times. They played away out in Cincinnati for the rich people. We'd stand outside and listen.
